Capturing messages for your organization’s compliance archive.
This app archives the messages on this device for your organization’s compliance records. To begin, sign in to your organization.
Don’t have an organization yet? Sign up on the web, then return here to connect this device.
This device is managed by your organization. Setup will complete automatically; no sign-in is required.
Signing in the first time requires a connection. This screen will continue automatically once you’re back online.
Message archiving isn’t enabled for your organization yet. Ask your administrator to turn it on, then try again.
That took too long and the sign-in expired. Please try connecting again.
Sign-in didn’t complete. Please try connecting again.
Couldn’t reach your organization. Check your connection and try again.
That doesn’t look like a valid organization address. It should start with https://
Your organization’s sign-in configuration couldn’t be verified. Double-check the address with your administrator.
Self-test passed: capture and upload are working.
Self-test couldn’t complete. Check your connection and that archiving is enabled.
Offline – capture continues; uploads resume when back online
Storage is full. Captured messages are safe and will upload once space is freed; nothing has been discarded.
The message queue could not be opened, so archiving is paused on this device. Nothing captured so far has been discarded. Restart the app; if this keeps showing, contact your administrator.

To keep your organization’s compliance archive, this app reads the SMS, MMS, and RCS messages stored on this device and securely sends them to your organization’s archive.

What is captured: message text, participants, timestamps, and attachments.

Your organization administers this archive. Messages are encrypted on this device before they are sent. The app does not show ads and does not sell your data.

A permanent notification will let you know whenever archiving is active.
Reads messages on this device and sends them, encrypted, to your organization’s compliance archive. Administered by your organization.
